name: Three-winding transformer
summary: A three-winding transformer couples three windings through its magnetic system.
description: A three-winding transformer couples three windings through its magnetic system. Each winding has its own voltage, connection and loading information, so a third winding must remain visible in the drawing and equipment schedule.
readingNotes: Determine whether the third winding is intended for a load, a tertiary function or another documented purpose.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A third winding is different from a tap on a single winding.
